thesis: Bloodline purity is a cage built on erasure and cameras watch every lie.

scenes.summary: Alex opens the genetic envelope in the sterile lab under red cameras and learns his blood is pure, erased from the registry.
scenes.goal: Read the sealed genetic results without being seen.
scenes.obstacle: Surveillance cameras and the lab's sealed registry.
scenes.turn: Alex learns his blood is pure and was erased.
scenes.cost: He is now a marked anomaly if anyone logs the file.
scenes.hook: Why did they erase a pure bloodline?

scenes.summary: Alex sits again in the sterile lab under red cameras, rereading that his blood is pure and the registry erased him.
scenes.goal: Confirm the sealed genetic results a second time.
scenes.obstacle: The same surveillance cameras and sealed registry.
scenes.turn: Alex learns his blood is pure and was erased.
scenes.cost: He remains a marked anomaly if anyone logs the file.
scenes.hook: Why did they erase a pure bloodline?

prose: The sterile air stung. Red cameras tracked him. Bloodline purity is a cage built on erasure and cameras watch every lie. He stood in the sterile air while red cameras watched the purity cage close.
